issue.title: Restrict Pomodoro carry-forward classification to direct child bullets
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-1m.2 while landing epic bob-cli-1m. Verified independently on bob-plugins master at 66d97cc. classifyPomodoroSubBullets scans every physical line in the Pomodoro child range, so a deeper descendant line containing a block link is independently classified and carried into the follow-on Pomodoro with deep indentation. This predates bob-cli-1m and was explicitly out of scope. Restrict carry-forward and transcluded-task classification to direct children of the Pomodoro while leaving descendant note trees in place, add focused regression coverage, bump task-status-cycler, and deploy.

task_type_fields.impact: Ctrl+Enter duplicates descendant note links into the next Pomodoro as malformed deeply indented carry-forward bullets instead of treating only direct Pomodoro child bullets as work items.
task_type_fields.repro: On current bob-plugins master, classify a Pomodoro range containing one direct child Task Link and beneath it a more deeply indented descendant block link. classifyPomodoroSubBullets returns both physical lines in copyableTaskLinkBullets, and buildPomodoroCompletionPlan carries both into copiedBulletLines.

payload.description: Both fixes change Pomodoro carry-forward planning and classification; coordinate tests and manifest bump if worked concurrently.
Both touch task-status-cycler Pomodoro completion helpers and could collide in the same release.
